title: UAAP: Garces, Bation power UP past Ateneo
summary: Josh Garces and Ramil Bation both grabbed a brace to send defending champion University of the Philippines to a 4-2 win over Ateneo de Manila University, Thursday at the UP Diliman Football Stadium.
